newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $875 mln in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $875 mln in Sept.

text.p: Brazil's commercial and financial foreign exchange transactions showed a preliminary surplus of $875 million in September in the forex commercial market, against a $1.506 billion surplus in August, bankers said.
Lower dollar inflows were mostly due to a drop in financial buy operations and an increase in Eurobond payments, dealers said.
Financial buy operations totalled $4.050 billion in September, according to Central Bank data supplied to banks. Financial sell operations amounted to $4.238 billion last month.
Dealers said September contracted exports were $4.490 billion against $3.427 billion in import operations.
